description: Fishing Assistant Firestore collection ownership registry.

_migrations.description: Applied migration ledger for repository-managed Firestore changes.

fishing_conversations.description: User-owned chat conversation metadata with soft-delete state.

fishing_conversation_messages.description: User-owned conversation messages, including completed and failed assistant responses.

fa_chat_runtime_settings.description: Chat-service-owned runtime settings such as the active chat model.

fa_answer_gap_candidates.description: Chat-service-owned pending user-consent records for detected Answer Gaps before admin-visible sharing.

fa_knowledge_nodes.description: Knowledge Base tree nodes for root, category, section, and page hierarchy.

fa_knowledge_pages.description: Knowledge Base page records with markdown, source metadata, and effective access state.

fa_knowledge_chunks.description: RAG chunks derived from Knowledge Base pages with effective access metadata.

fa_knowledge_access_refresh_jobs.description: Knowledge Base access refresh jobs for category and page effective-access changes.

fa_knowledge_access_audits.description: Knowledge Base access consistency audit records for chunks, revisions, and source URLs.

fa_answer_gaps.description: Admin-facing backlog of user questions the assistant could not answer from accessible retrieved Knowledge Base evidence.

llm_usage_events.description: Immutable LLM usage and cost tracking events.

llm_usage_daily_aggregates.description: Daily aggregated token and cost totals.

llm_pricing.description: Provider/model pricing catalog used by usage accounting.

fa_users.description: FA user profiles, Auth0 identity bindings, authorization role/status/tier, and soft-delete state.

fa_user_identity_reservations.description: Deterministic Auth0 subject and normalized-email reservation documents used to enforce user identity uniqueness transactionally.

fa_user_change_events.description: Immutable user profile, status, role, and tier change history.
